title: tragacantha coquimbensis
intro: Tragacantha coquimbensis, commonly known as Coquimbense thistle, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Cynara genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha coquimbensis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
